factual_claims.claim: Property expenses declined 6.1% to SEK 4,378 million, reflecting cost controls, digitalisation, efficiency measures, and the smaller portfolio following property disposals.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Property Expenses section states 'On an annual basis, property expenses decreased by 6.1% to SEK 4,378 million (4,661) million... driven by cost control measures including digitalisation... and the shrinking portfolio size'.

factual_claims.claim: These improvements offset higher utility costs, which increased because municipal price increases exceeded core CPI.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Utilities section states 'For the year, utilities increased by 5.7% to SEK 1,095 million (1,036). The increase is driven by price increases from municipal providers outpacing core CPI increases.'

factual_claims.claim: Profit before tax rose to SEK 16,012 million from SEK 10,403 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income shows profit before tax of SEK 16,012 million (2025) vs SEK 10,403 million (2024).

factual_claims.claim: The result benefited from a SEK 9,498 million fair-value gain on investment properties, compared with SEK 8,554 million in 2024, realised disposal gains of SEK 2,207 million, and foreign-exchange gains of SEK 3,996 million versus a loss of SEK 2,038 million a year earlier.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income shows fair value adjustment of SEK 9,498 million (2025) vs SEK 8,554 million (2024), realised gains of SEK 2,207 million (2025) vs SEK 1,687 million (2024), and FX gains of SEK 3,996 million (2025) vs loss of SEK 2,038 million (2024).

factual_claims.claim: However, the company recognised a SEK 3,707 million goodwill impairment, primarily relating to Germany and Sweden, as higher discount rates reduced the recoverable value of Akelius-related goodwill.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income shows goodwill impairment of SEK 3,707 million. Note 3.2 details the impairment relating to Akelius goodwill, with specific allocation to Germany and Sweden.

factual_claims.claim: Net profit increased to SEK 13,056 million from SEK 7,621 million, although total comprehensive income declined to SEK 4,199 million from SEK 11,082 million because currency translation losses reached SEK 8,857 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income shows profit of SEK 13,056 million (2025) vs SEK 7,621 million (2024) and comprehensive income of SEK 4,199 million (2025) vs SEK 11,082 million (2024). Note 2.9 details currency translation losses of SEK 8,857 million.

factual_claims.claim: The property portfolio generated a 3.0% fair-value increase during the year, but total investment property value declined to SEK 324,429 million from SEK 335,422 million after disposals and currency effects.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Investment Properties section states 'Change in fair value of investment properties, for the year were SEK 9,498 million (8,553) corresponding to 3% (2.6%) of fair value... The total fair value of investment properties at year end was SEK 324,429 million (335,422)'.

factual_claims.claim: Denmark and Czechia recorded particularly strong value growth.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Country Fair Value Development section shows Denmark with an annual increase of SEK 4,643 million (7.2%) and Czechia with SEK 1,856 million (6.7%).

factual_claims.claim: Privatisation sales amounted to SEK 10,664 million, covering 2,466 residential units sold at a 28.9% premium to book value.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A '2025 in Brief' states 'Privatisation sales of SEK 10,664 million; 2,466 residential units sold at a 28.9% premium to book value'.

factual_claims.claim: No new development or construction commitments were undertaken.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Outstanding Commitments section states 'For the year, neither Heimstaden nor Heimstaden’s subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad made any new commitments for new development and construction.'

factual_claims.claim: The balance sheet and credit position strengthened.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Alternative Performance Measures table shows improved net loan-to-value (52.2% vs 56.4%) and net debt/total assets (48.0% vs 51.0%). Consolidated Statement of Financial Position shows reduced interest-bearing liabilities.

factual_claims.claim: Net interest-bearing liabilities fell to SEK 170,212 million from SEK 190,381 million, reducing net loan-to-value to 52.2% from 56.4% and net debt to total assets to 48.0% from 51.0%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Alternative Performance Measures table confirms all figures: net interest-bearing liabilities SEK 170,212 million (2025) vs SEK 190,381 million (2024), Net LTV 52.2% vs 56.4%, Net Debt/Total Assets 48.0% vs 51.0%.

factual_claims.claim: Equity increased to SEK 150,557 million, and the equity ratio improved to 42.4%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position shows equity of SEK 150,557 million (2025) vs SEK 147,803 million (2024). Alternative Performance Measures table shows equity ratio of 42.4% vs 39.6%.

factual_claims.claim: Interest expense was stable at SEK 6,536 million, while the interest coverage ratio improved to 2.0x from 1.9x.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Alternative Performance Measures table shows interest expenses of SEK 6,536 million (2025) vs SEK 6,554 million (2024) and ICR of 2.0x vs 1.9x.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow was SEK 2,742 million, and year-end cash was SEK 4,179 million, supplemented by SEK 23,449 million in unused credit facilities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows shows operating cash flow of SEK 2,742 million. Consolidated Statement of Financial Position shows cash and cash equivalents of SEK 4,179 million. Liquidity Management section states unutilised credit facilities of SEK 23,449 million.

factual_claims.claim: The group completed approximately SEK 59.5 billion of financing transactions, while Fitch maintained a B- rating but revised the outlook to negative.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Funding section states 'For the year, Heimstaden’s subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad completed approximately SEK 59,500 million... financing markets remained strong'. MD&A '2025 in Brief' notes 'In January 2025, Fitch ratings affirmed the ‘B-‘ and revised the Outlook to Negative'.

factual_claims.claim: A potential one-off accounting loss of approximately SEK 3 billion is expected in 2026 when the Kojamo investment is reclassified.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events After the Reporting Period section states 'Subsequent to the balance sheet date, Kojamo Oyj announced the acquisition of a housing portfolio to be settled by issuing new shares... A one-off accounting loss of approximately SEK 3 billion is anticipated.'
